test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Sugestion**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Sugestion**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Suggestion**'. • It means **'a plan or idea that somebody mentions for somebody else to discuss and consider'**. [(चर्चा या विचार हेतु) कोई सुझाव (कोई योजना या राय)] • *Example: May I make a **suggestion**?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Mediocre**: of not very high quality. [औसत दर्जे का (उच्‍च कोटि का नहीं), दरम्‍याना, साधारण] • **Legible**: that is clear enough to be read easily. (इतना साफ़ कि पढ़ने में आसानी हो; सुवाच्‍य, सुपाठ्‌य) • **Opaque**: that you cannot see through. (अपारदर्शी) 41:T62d, The correct answer is **'To have no idea of the answer'.**
